w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Marisol is calling it "Old Gavel." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering The Terms of Service gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
Marisol heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably." They've been meaning to check on their people.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — the haven's talking about nothing else.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/13/8), with 5 wave-4 fought, 20 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 1 · Forage 13 · Craft 11 · Talk 28 → 24 · capped · Explore 33 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yuki Mori ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
